_comment: Local model served by Ollama. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works — env vars in .env override everything here. See SETUP.md for the Ollama install steps.
_model_notes: llama3.2:3b — English-only, ~2GB, fast enough for CPU-only inference (roughly 3-5s for a parent message). Alternatives at the same size: gemma3:4b (stronger writing, ~1s slower) or phi4-mini (3.8b). Avoid the larger tiers unless you have a GPU.
_timeout_notes: These two must be set together: max_tokens / (CPU tokens-per-sec) must fit inside timeoutMs, or a long reply is killed mid-generation and the teacher sees 'AI unavailable' instead of a slow success. 180 tokens at a pessimistic 10 tok/s needs ~18s, so 25s leaves ~40% headroom. The original 400 tokens against a 12s timeout could not fit under any CPU speed. If you move to a GPU, both can drop sharply.
_qwen_notes: Only applied when the model name contains 'qwen' — harmless to leave in place on other models.
